en: Monochrome/yellow-tinted image bordered in yellow, showing a broad tree-lined avenue leading to a large stone gatehouse or city gate with an arched passageway. The building has a row of small square windows above the arch and decorative stonework around the central portal. Several pedestrians are visible near the gate; one person stands closer to the camera on the right side of the road. The scene suggests an old fortified entrance to a town or park, photographed in an early-20th‑century style. No visible caption or writing appears on the front.
